title: Seed config
description: The once-per-target human seed for the Seeded-Session + LLM Exploration Loop (Phase A). The human logs in once (handling SSO/MFA/CAPTCHA) so Playwright can save a storageState; scans then start already authenticated and replay the seed routes. deny_actions/exploration are consumed by the Phase B exploration loop. File contents are JSON (a valid YAML subset), matching the repo's zap-policy convention. See docs/junior_engineer/seeded_session_exploration_design.md.

base_url.description: Target as the browser/ZAP reaches it, e.g. http://juice:3000

scope_file.description: Path to the app scope.json (validated by preflight before any traffic).

storage_state.description: Path to the Playwright storageState (cookies + localStorage) saved by the human seed step. MUST be gitignored (holds live session secrets).

seed_routes.description: Known authenticated entry-point routes; the seeded replay visits these and the exploration loop starts from them.

deny_actions.description: Destructive actions to never perform (Phase B). Enforced deterministically, not by LLM judgment.

exploration.description: Budgets bounding the Phase B exploration loop.
